name: Velanir Egress Guard
description: Revises natural final answers in context and strips protected runtime details from outbound messages.

mode.label: Mode
mode.help: off disables the guard, shadow records decisions without changing delivery, and enforce revises, sanitizes, or suppresses outbound text.

channels.label: Protected Channels
channels.help: Channel ids whose outbound messages are evaluated. Defaults to Slack and Microsoft Teams.

finalOutput.mode.label: Final Output Revision
finalOutput.mode.help: when_needed asks the active coworker model for one more pass only on risky drafts; always applies one bounded final wording pass.

finalOutput.style.label: Final Output Style
finalOutput.style.help: plain is concise and neutral; friendly allows restrained professional warmth.

finalOutput.maxEmojis.label: Maximum Emojis
finalOutput.maxEmojis.help: Maximum emoji count in the delivered message.

finalOutput.forbidEmDash.label: Avoid Em Dashes
finalOutput.forbidEmDash.help: Replaces em dashes in final outbound text with simpler punctuation.
